items.title: Mozambique: Government to implement concession system for maritime cabotage
items.summary: Mozambican government plans to implement a concession system for maritime cabotage by June 2027, as part of measures designed to consolidate the maritime transport of goods and strengthen coordination between different modes of transport. According to the Minister of Transport and Logistics, João Matlombe, speaking on Thursday at the close of the Ministry’s 2nd Coordinating… Source
